title: Count The Number Of Beautiful Subarrays
description:
In one operation, choose two different indices whose values both have a set bit at position `b`, then subtract `2^b` from both values. A nonempty subarray is beautiful if repeated operations can make every value zero. Return the number of beautiful subarrays.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [4,3,1,2,4]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: nums = [1,10,4]
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `0 <= nums[i] <= 10^6`
